name: King George's Playing Fields Play Area
description: A play area in Brentwood, on Brentwood Borough Council's list of its play areas. It is the borough's largest play area, with an adventure play area for ages 8 and over and a splash pad for younger children that opens on warmer days. The playing fields have a car park and public toilets.
